title: job.resume (v1) — Engine to adapter worker
description: Asks a worker to continue a lookup that stopped for a human answer. It carries everything job.track carries, plus the intervention and the saved session. The answer itself is NOT in the message: the worker fetches it from the Engine's internal API with intervention_id. Same attempt as the job.track it continues; the broker may deliver it more than once.

timeout_ms.description: Adapter execution budget, measured by the worker from the moment execution starts. Queue time is not deducted.

expires_at.description: Queue-wait deadline. A worker drops a FIRST delivery received after this instant; redeliveries are always executed. Independent of timeout_ms.

credential_ref.description: Opaque reference to the credential the adapter needs; never the secret. The worker exchanges it for the secret over the Engine's internal API. Absent when no credential is needed.

intervention_id.description: The answered intervention. The worker exchanges it for the user's answer over the internal API (allowed only for this job and attempt).

session_ref.description: The session reference the worker sent in job.intervention_required.
